title: Security: upgrade Next.js 16.2.2 → 16.2.6 (SSRF + auth bypass CVEs)
implementation_notes: Run `npm install next@16.2.6`, verify `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build` pass. The `^16.2.2` range in package.json already allows the patch — just `npm install` may be enough; pin exact version to 16.2.6 for safety. No code changes expected — pure dependency bump.

title: A11y: MatchTracker delete — Escape dismiss, focus management, error feedback
implementation_notes: Audit already completed (r8-accessibility-16-05-26.md). Fix Issues C, D, E in MatchTracker.tsx: (C) change delete confirm/cancel from `min-h-[32px]` to `min-h-[44px]`; (D) replace delete trigger `p-1` with `min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center`; (E) add `aria-pressed={result === r}` to Win/Loss/Tie buttons. Also add Escape key handler to dismiss the inline confirm state, and return focus to the delete trigger button after cancel/dismiss.

title: Bug: iOS PWA install prompt silently never fires on non-scrolling pages
implementation_notes: PWA research (r-pwa-15-05-26.md) confirmed: iOS path shows after a fixed 45-second delay, but `beforeinstallprompt` never fires on iOS at all (Apple restriction). The real fix is switching from a time-based trigger to an engagement-based trigger (e.g., after user completes a meaningful action like first share or first report view). Also add a persistent low-pressure install entry in the navbar or settings menu so users who dismissed the sheet can re-invoke. The 15-second Android timer should also be replaced with an engagement trigger to avoid mid-read interruptions.

title: UX: Add unlisted privacy tier (draft → unlisted → public)
implementation_notes: Design doc (vgc190-design-17-05-26.md) complete. Strategy B: additive `ALTER TABLE shares ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_unlisted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE`. No downtime, no backfill. API: add `isUnlisted` to ShareBodySchema in share/route.ts and reports/[shareId]/route.ts; filter unlisted from explore/route.ts, sitemap, feeds (same as is_public=FALSE). UI: replace binary toggle in ShareModal.tsx and DashboardContent.tsx with a 3-state picker (Private / Unlisted / Public). Current 'UNLISTED' badge (which actually means private) should be repurposed correctly.

title: Growth: Email capture for weekly meta update newsletter
implementation_notes: Resend is already wired (src/lib/email.ts). Build: (1) new API route POST /api/newsletter/subscribe — validate email, store in a `subscribers` table (or use Resend Audiences API if RESEND_API_KEY is set), return 201; (2) NewsletterSignup.tsx — small inline form with email input + subscribe button, respect consent (ConsentGate pattern); (3) embed in homepage below hero and optionally in dashboard sidebar. Gate behind RESEND_API_KEY env var (silent skip if missing). Use Resend Audiences endpoint `POST /audiences/{id}/contacts` if audience ID is configured, else store locally in DB.
